title: Scrapbook: the Wigwam band with Archie Marder
summary: The Wigwam lineup with singing pianist Archie Marder.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: When you were at the wigwam, Archie, master of piano, what is his name? Archie Marder.
I don't know if I spelled it.
Marder. Yeah, I don't know how to spell that either. Gene Mard, Joe Bazile, Donald Sewell, Bill Cray, and yourself, yeah.
Archie could really sing like Mario Lancia. Mm-hmm.
I guess that made the band go over good, huh? Yeah, it did.
It helped him. Because he could sing fine.
